items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Now when I tell guys I played with him, they say, man you're older than you are.

ctx.x: Is he a relative of Buddy Petit, says Buddy?

It is a Petit, that's it. Old man Petit. I think it's the old man, it's Buddy's brother or his daddy, one of the two. Now when I tell guys I played with him, they say, man you're older than you are. But the old man was gone during that time, he was just hanging on, you know. Well all the fellas was older than me when I played with that particular band. They're always old men, I was a young fella, a young boy. When I played with, played them two Jo with those two particular fellas like I tell them. That's the man…
